title: Satellite Contract Rules
description: Rules defining the required and optional structure of satellite evolith.yaml files. These contracts enable the federated governance model.

required.rationale: API version enables future governance format evolution without breaking existing satellites.
Kind distinguishes Evolith resources (Satellite, Policy, Standard) in the same repository.
Name is the satellite's identity in governance tooling and Architecture Board communications.

required.constraint: Must be F1, F2, or F3
required.rationale: Phase determines which architecture rules apply. F1 is mandatory starting point unless exception approved.
Tracks architectural evolution of the satellite independently of product version.

required.constraint: semver format, must reference existing Evolith Core version
required.rationale: Core version pin ensures reproducible governance validation.
Ruleset version allows Core to publish rule updates without bumping full Core version.

required.constraint: Must be one of: TypeScript, CSharp, Kotlin, Go, Python
required.rationale: Runtime language determines which runtime-specific ADRs and patterns apply.
Framework identifies the specific framework (NestJS, ASP.NET Core, Spring Boot) for pattern enforcement.
SDLC phase determines which gate rules and artifact requirements apply.

optional.description: Chain of inheritance if satellite extends another satellite
List of bounded contexts in this satellite
Local ADRs maintained by this satellite
Active quality waivers with expiration dates

rules.title: Each satellite project must have exactly one evolith.yaml at its project root
rules.enforcement: CLI validates a single evolith.yaml at each satellite project's root. A manifest nested within another project's tree is prohibited. A satellite workspace (monorepo) declares its project roots in evolith.workspace.yaml; a single-repo satellite is the degenerate one-project workspace (backward compatible). Amended by ADR-0109 from repo-scoped to project-scoped.
rules.description: CLI validates a single evolith.yaml at each satellite project's root. A manifest nested within another project's tree is prohibited. A satellite workspace (monorepo) declares its project roots in evolith.workspace.yaml; a single-repo satellite is the degenerate one-project workspace.

rules.title: Satellite name must be unique across all Evolith satellites
rules.enforcement: CLI checks against Evolith satellite registry before allowing first push.
rules.description: CLI checks against Evolith satellite registry before allowing first push.

rules.title: F1 phase satellites must reference core/ADR-0047 in spec.compliance.adrRegistry
rules.enforcement: Satellites in F1 phase must include core/ADR-0047 confirming modular monolith starting point.
rules.description: Satellites in F1 phase must include core/ADR-0047 confirming modular monolith starting point.

rules.title: Satellites in F2 or F3 must have extraction readiness score documented
rules.enforcement: Satellites with phase F2 or F3 must have core/ADR-0045 assessment with score >= 70% (F2) or >= 80% (F3).
rules.description: Satellites with phase F2 or F3 must have core/ADR-0045 assessment with score >= 70% (F2) or >= 80% (F3).

rules.title: Core version referenced must exist in Evolith Core registry
rules.enforcement: CLI validates coreRef.version against Evolith Core releases. Unknown versions trigger error.
rules.description: CLI validates coreRef.version against Evolith Core releases. Unknown versions trigger error.

rules.title: Workspace integrity: declared projects and discovered manifests must correspond one-to-one
rules.enforcement: In a satellite workspace, every evolith.yaml discovered under the workspace must correspond to a declared spec.projects[].path in evolith.workspace.yaml, and every declared project path must contain an evolith.yaml. Single-project satellites (no evolith.workspace.yaml) are exempt. Introduced by ADR-0109.
rules.description: Every evolith.yaml found in a workspace must correspond to a declared spec.projects[].path, and vice versa — no undeclared (stray/nested) project manifests and no declared project missing its manifest.

migrationRules.title: Satellite can upgrade governance version via CLI upgrade command
migrationRules.description: CLI automates version update, rule diff review, and CI validation

migrationRules.title: Phase transition (F1 → F2 → F3) requires Architecture Board approval artifact
migrationRules.description: Phase transition is not automated. Board must review and explicitly approve before satellite updates metadata.phase

migrationRules.title: Satellite archival: satellite marks itself as Deprecated in evolith.yaml
migrationRules.description: Deprecated satellites are retained for audit but no longer receive Core rule updates
